student_distillation_label: Collect pre-action326D observation -> complete clipped executed_target_full, never residual_action alone

turn_slew_definition: Turn residual offset changes by at most turn_offset_rate_deg_s*dt, inferred from previous actually executed target and previous reference; first reset command warm-starts the existing balance correction

turn_lift_config.acceptance: No count ratio, cadence ceiling, cooldown or frequency termination. Counts are diagnostic only.

added_observation: yaw integral + contact swing ages and cycle counts; no lift budget
task_target_scope: explicit source commands; body-relative end effectors; no world reference XY/yaw tracking

reward_metadata.task_boundary_settlement: Only natural physical death or full episode timeout; signed integral(yaw_dot), norm integral(world XY velocity); translations30deg, turns0.20m. No early task-boundary termination.
reward_metadata.foot_frame: fore: shoulder midpoint/chest; hind: hip midpoint/calibrated pelvis; no global XY/yaw imitation
reward_metadata.gravity_alignment_definition: -2*(gravity_angle_error/10deg)^2; exact match zero, no positive baseline; root/chest only
reward_metadata.cross_motion_definition: turns: -2*min((horizontal_speed/0.03)^2,4), cap -8/s; translations unchanged: -0.2*u^2/(1+u^2/4), u=cross_speed/0.06, cap -0.8/s
reward_metadata.contact_timing_definition: -2*mean(actual_contact != (reference_contact_probability>=0.5)); every control step, all four feet; no timing deadband
reward_metadata.translation_yaw_rate_definition: translations only: -2*min((yaw_rate_error/0.10rad_s)^2,4), cap -8/s; pure turns excluded
reward_metadata.historical_boundary_curriculum_not_activ: turns only; reset-relative rootXY radius 0.30m -> 0.20m once >=19/20 complete held-out episodes survive without crossing. Translations: reset-relative yaw 30deg -> 20deg -> 10deg, same independent 19/20 full-episode gate; replaces continuous heading-integral penalty. Other previous-version rewards preserved.

turn_task_revision.yaw: Dense cycle progress: 6*T*(0.99*Phi(p_new)-Phi(p_old))/dt; p=signed integral(yaw_rate*dt)/(abs(command)*T); Phi=min(p,1)-0.15*max(p-1,0)^2 bounded below at -2. Complete-cycle discounted sum=6*T*0.99^N*Phi(p_final). Initial partial cycle excluded; only a physical-fall terminal cancels unfinished potential. Artificial timeouts retain Phi(next) to match gamma*V(pre_reset_obs) bootstrap; complete wraps retain cycle payoff. Raw timeout rollout return excludes the critic bootstrap and is not a completed-cycle-only score.
turn_task_revision.period: unchanged reference phase/contact timing; full-cycle cadence count checked
turn_task_revision.cycle_event: up to +2 per completed cycle, drift/phase gated; reverse negative, extra/missing lifts -0.1 each; partial reset cycles excluded

reward_metadata.fall_definition: per fall -(20 + sum of other same-transition negative costs); timeout excluded; displayed rates are not per-event amounts
reward_metadata.contact_detector: Force hysteresis: contact >=1N; leave <=0.3N AND capsule clearance >1mm; no long debounce; reset air is not a liftoff
reward_metadata.symmetry: Straight walk/trot only; actual anatomy-local XY compared to mirrored opposite foot half a reference period earlier
reward_metadata.aggregation: sum of continuous rates * dt + event costs; no positive-only clipping
reward_metadata.removed: All v44 reward modules, strict step width/height/distance/angle targets, raw upstroke taxes, cadence budgets, inverse duration, extra alive rewards, joint pose/velocity imitation, hard-coded waist=-40deg termination
reward_metadata.termination: Nonfinite, severe tilt/low body, prohibited body/knee contact, passive coupling; time limit. No cadence termination.
